messages:
Maria G: Heads-up — noticed a persistent dip in RI utilization for ap-southeast-1 p4d fleet over last 12 days (from ~88% to ~62%).
Sam T: I saw that, looks like a mix of reduced training jobs + more dev sandbox usage. Cost delta ~ $18k/mo if trend holds.
Devon P: Is the drop uniform across AZs or concentrated? Any networking throttles or scheduling delays?
Sam T: Mostly az1 and az2. Batch queue logs show longer pod pending times during night windows. Linking sample: https://s3.redwood/diag/1745/pending-samples.txt
infra-bot: Alert: ReservedInstanceUtilization ap-southeast-1 decreased by 26% (12d window) — ticket #INF-4521 opened.
Kai L: Quick options:
- exchange RI to different instance class (exchange window available?)
- sell on RI marketplace (loss risk)
- rehome workloads to use dedicated spot hybrid and convert to SPs
We should run a 3-month projection and an exchange feasibility check.
Maria G: Exchange window is open but only convertible between families if same tenancy/region — need infra finance signoff. Sam, can you run a 3mo forecast with two scenarios: (A) rehome 30% workloads to other regions, (B) sell 20% on marketplace + buy SP for burst.
Sam T: On it. Quick numbers: If we rehome 30% --> utilization up to 78% and saves ~$9k/mo. Marketplace sale best-case recovers ~$45k but risk of extended market exposure.
Devon P: Network note — cross-region rehome adds ~12–18ms to trainer sync; will need to validate gradient-allreduce tolerance. Also nodes in eu-west have lower spot capacity at night.
Maria G: Can infra eng prepare a short playbook for rehoming (network config changes, peering, egress) and a runbook for marketplace sale steps? Tagging @devops.
Sam T: I'll attach the forecast CSV when ready. Minimal CLI we used to check RIs:
```
aws ec2 describe-reserved-instances --region ap-southeast-1 --filters Name=state,Values=active
aws ce get-reservation-utilization --time-period Start=2024-10-01,End=2024-12-31
```
Kai L: Suggest we schedule a quick decision sync tomorrow 9:30 PT. If we go exchange path, we need to lock by end of week to avoid next quarter budget gap. :calendar:
Maria G: Agreed. Meeting scheduled. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
